title: Obsession
paragraphs: A poorly documented early-1950s syndicated anthology of thriller and suspense dramas. Because reliable production records are limited, individual dates and numbering are not asserted unless independently supported.
Psychological mystery/drama anthology centered on destructive fixations and personal conflict. Specialist references describe 78 programs produced for the 1950-1952 WBBM/MacGregor run.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: WBBM filler / early syndication (October 9, 1950 to January 8, 1951) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] and Regular Monday WBBM / syndication run (January 15, 1951 to May 12, 1952) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include C. P. MacGregor (producer and host), Barry Sullivan (performer), Barton Yarborough (performer), Elliott Lewis (performer), Ann Gwynn (performer), Annabella (performer), and Bonita Granville (performer).

The stories often return to obsession, fixation and destructive desire, death, vengeance and mortal danger, crime, murder and criminal schemes, isolation, houses, sea and confinement, supernatural or uncanny fear, and identity, amnesia and impersonation.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Postwar psychological mystery anthology, WBBM Chicago and MacGregor syndication, AFRS and AFRTS rebroadcast preservation, and Partial survival of a 78-program run.
